steps.name: basics
steps.label: Basics
steps.description: Deploy a Flexible-orchestration VMSS from the golden image built in Step 1. The sensor is baked into the image (NO_START=1); each instance auto-starts it and registers a unique AID on first boot. Provide the local administrator credentials.

location.label: Region
location.toolTip: Region for the VMSS, networking, and load balancer.

elements.name: adminUsername
elements.label: Administrator username
elements.toolTip: Local administrator username for the VMSS instances.

validations.message: 1-20 letters or numbers. Avoid reserved names like 'administrator'.

elements.name: adminPassword
elements.toolTip: Local administrator password. Azure Windows complexity: 12-123 chars incl. lowercase, uppercase, number, and a special character.

constraints.validationMessage: 12-123 characters, including lowercase, uppercase, a number, and a special character.

elements.name: keyVaultName
elements.label: Key Vault name
elements.toolTip: The Key Vault created by Step 1 (shown in Step 1's deployment outputs).

validations.message: 3-24 chars, start with a letter, alphanumeric/hyphen, no trailing hyphen.

elements.name: imageVersion
elements.label: Image version
elements.toolTip: Golden image version to deploy. Use 'latest' or pin an exact version.

validations.message: Use 'latest' or an exact version like 20348.5499.260809.

elements.name: imageDefinitionName
elements.label: Image definition name
elements.toolTip: The image definition created by Step 1 (shown in Step 1's outputs as imageDefinitionName, e.g. CrowdStrike-Windows-2025). Must match exactly.

validations.message: Enter the image definition name from Step 1 (no spaces).

elements.name: instanceCount
elements.label: Instance count
elements.toolTip: Number of VM instances in the scale set.

elements.name: vmSize
elements.label: VM size
elements.toolTip: Size for the scale set instances.
